Ethan / team — I checked with provisioning: +60 GPU hours for the pilot month is doable as a one-time top-up. Two follow-ups:

1) Billing/proration options (pick one):

Thanks — reviewed the attached RW-redlines-exhibitB.docx. High-level guidance:

- This is a scope/implementation exhibit change only; an Order Form addendum is sufficient. We do not need to amend the MSA text unless the customer requests contract-level changes (data handling, SLAs, indemnities).
- Redline comments: ensure Exhibit B defines who owns rollback decisions (customer ok vs vendor gating) and make the acceptance gates objective (smoke tests, latency thresholds).
- On billing: Option A (one-time line item) is cleanest. Draft language we need in the addendum: line-item name, quantity (60 GPU-hours), unit price (per-hour rate), and reference that charges are non-refundable and will be invoiced within 30 days of activation.
- PO/Procurement: ask Clearwave procurement to include the order-form addendum reference number; we'll include the addendum ID in DocuSign so finance can reconcile.

Attached a short annotated version of the redline with legal comments (I edited the Docx). I can convert these into clean contract text if you confirm Option A.
